name: Poster (print)
numbersAre: working defaults. Ask the print shop for their size, bleed, and file rules first.

canvas.unit: Design at 96 px per inch in Figma. Export at a scale that gives 300 dpi at final size.

viewing.across room: Headline readable from 2 m: 72 pt or more

hierarchy.rule: One focal point. The eye finds the title first, the proof second, the detail last.

print.colorMode: Figma is RGB only. Export PDF and convert to CMYK in the print tool. Bright oranges and greens shift.
print.blackText: Use rich black only for large areas. Small text in 100 K.

layout.grid: Pick a grid. Align to it. Leave empty space on purpose.

later: CMYK PDF/X in a print tool

notObservable: How it looks from a distance (print a small copy and step back)
